brief: A tool caddy with a carry handle and divided bins for screws and bits.

requirements.evidence: Three base cells in a triangle (pieces 0,0 / 1,0 / 0,1), joints bolted with jointBolts, open faces capped except two on cell 0,0, one of which holds the handle. Mesh check clear.

Grab handle accessory:0#0,0#3 on the side of cell 0,0. The top-mounted Trinity handle had no place to fit, so the handle is on the side and off-centre. The configurator does not check whether it can take the weight of a loaded caddy.
bin:0,0,0 and bin:1,0,0 (hex-bin-half-div3), 6 compartments, shown with screws, nuts and standoffs.
bin:0,1,0 (hex-bin-half-div2), 2 compartments, shown with a pile of screws and an upright hex key set (there is no drill-bit prop).

finish.summary: A three-cell caddy (pieces at 0,0 / 1,0 / 0,1) with two half-depth bins of 3 compartments (6 sections for screws, nuts and standoffs) and one half-depth bin of 2 compartments for bits (a pile of screws and an upright hex key set stand in for them). It has a grab handle on the side of cell 0,0. The top-mounted Trinity handle had no place to fit on this build. Open faces are capped except two on cell 0,0, one of which holds the handle; the joints are bolted. The check passed with no rule errors and no mesh collisions. 16 parts, about 1.4 kg of filament.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

parts.name: Grab handle
parts.use: A bar standing off the flat with room for a hand behind it, for a cell or a column that gets moved by its side rather than its top.

parts.name: Trinity handle
parts.use: Reaches across a whole triangle of studs, so a lift is shared between recesses instead of hanging off one, and the cell can be carried loaded.
